headline: Sensex, Nifty rally on Reliance buying, foreign inflows, and US Fed holding interest rates unchanged

marketStatus.message: Market is open for trading today.

why: The US Federal Reserve held interest rates unchanged, boosting global market sentiment.
Renewed foreign fund inflows and buying in heavyweights like Reliance supported the market rally.
Strong quarterly earnings reports from companies like City Union Bank and Vedanta Aluminium boosted investor confidence.
Adani group stocks surged up to 3%, adding Rs 23,000 crore to their total market capitalization.
whatHappening: Sensex jumped over 500 to 600 points while Nifty traded above the 22,800 level.
City Union Bank shares surged 7% following a 27% YoY increase in Q2 net profit to Rs 416 crore.
Vedanta Aluminium reported a 41% surge in revenue to Rs 22,066 crore and more than doubled its net profit.
The Indian Rupee hit a two-week low amidst sticky dollar demand, despite modest interventions.
summary: Indian benchmark indices Sensex and Nifty traded higher today, buoyed by foreign fund inflows and buying in heavyweights like Reliance after the US Fed kept interest rates unchanged. Strong quarterly earnings from City Union Bank and Vedanta Aluminium further improved market mood. Adani Group stocks and major gainers like PowerGrid also contributed significantly to the market rally.
